shared_elements: human or humanoid figure in profile
interlaced or repeated linear ornament filling the field
band or framing register dividing the field
justification: Both surfaces depict a figural subject combined with dense linear ornament, and both include a rod- or staff-like held element, but that is about as generic as correspondence gets. A shows a small-scale, flat, schematic scene of figures and a horse-drawn conveyance above a large field of symmetrical zoomorphic interlace, while B shows a single large, anatomically modelled winged bearded figure in profile filling the panel with a bucket and cone; the compositional logic, scale of figures and rendering conventions are entirely unrelated.
